text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spring is here once more. One day, just
when I'm
about to call an end to
Bamboo Memory's
training arc...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for another FIERY training
session!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come for us to
decide the
path Bamboo Memory will
take.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! Okay!
choice_data_list: 今後のレースについて、相談しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's talk about your upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've gleaned a lot from the training she's
done up
till now. After agonizing over
the information, I'm
left with only one
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: 短距離とマイルのレースを走ろう
choice_data_list_en: Let's run Sprint and Mile races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sprints and miles. As her trainer, I've
determined
that Bamboo Memory will be
at her best running
those two distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, that's just what I've
decided. None
of it means anything if
my suggestion doesn't
align with what
Bamboo Memory wants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's determined to run in medium and
long
distances like her friends and take
on the Classic
Triple Crown tour, then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how well I'll do in
sprints and
miles!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm okay with it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you believe that's the best way
for me to
reach the top and make my
dream come true,
right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And I trust you! If you say that's what I
should run,
then that's what I want to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words and eyes both convey her
trust in me,
and the uncertainty I felt
melts away. But a flicker
of doubt
remains... does she know what this

means?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know I could just keep this to myself, but I want Bamboo Memory to make an informed decision—this is her future, after all.
choice_data_list: ……ヤエノたちとは競いにくくなるぞ？
……ヤエノたちとは競いにくくなるよ？
choice_data_list_en: ...It'll be harder to compete against Yaeno and the others, you know?
...It'll be harder to compete against Yaeno and the others, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well... that's what happens when your
aptitudes
differ. Of course I'd like to run
with everyone,
but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I don't think now is the time for that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno, Chiyono O, Ardan—everyone has
a dream
they're striving for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And all those dreams are big, bright,
and
beautiful! It's AWESOME!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, when I think of them
becoming my
rivals alongside Oguri, I
wanna scream with joy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's why... I think the way I do.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I came here to meet life-changing rivals
and take
them on in red-hot, passionate
races! If I want to
make that a reality...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If I want to make my dream come true, I have to become a super awesome, ultra strong racer worthy of Yaeno and the others!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know your dream is to make me the
strongest
Umamusume, and I believe in
your dream more
than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm more than ready to take the skills you see in me and blaze down the path you've chosen!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sprint all-out down that road
because I
know it'll lead me right to my
dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Immediately, I want to live up to the
trust she
places in me. That desire sets
my heart alight,
banishing any remaining
uncertainty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to communicate that to her. As
her trainer,
it's my dream to lead her to
her dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Swan Stakes is a 1,400-meter G2
turf race
held at Kyoto Racecourse at
the end of October.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This graded sprint is known as the
battleground
where racers gather to
make a name for
themselves in miles and
sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect race for Bamboo Memory
to test
her distance aptitude!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to put everything I've
learned to
the test! Yaaaaah! I feel like
I'm on fire!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: 短距離とマイルが、君の戦場だ！
短距離とマイルが、貴方の戦場だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Sprints and Miles are your battleground!
Sprints and Miles are your battleground!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YEAH!
choice_data_list: そこで、世代の最強になろう！！
choice_data_list_en: Let's become the strongest of this generation there!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I gonna do it! I'm gonna be the best
racer in
sprints and miles! And after
that...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll be able to stand alongside everyone
in my
generation! I'll be right there with
my friends and
their passionate dreams!
That's how I'll reach my
red-hot rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: BAMBOO MEMORYYY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal race is the Swan Stakes!
The next
phase of Bamboo Memory's
racing career, her
classic year, starts
now!
